..Title
Resolution to Approve Amendment 1 to the Professional Services Agreement for On-Call Third Party Building, Rental and Planning Services with Carlisle Wortman Associates, Inc. (Amendment $300,000.00) (Total $750,000.00)
..Memorandum
Building and Rental Services seeks to expand the plan review and inspection services provided by Carlisle Wortman Associates, Inc. ("Carlisle Wortman") to ensure the level of inspections and plan review services remains consistent as building services transition staff, backfill open positions, and complete an RFP process. Bids for the RFP are due June 4, 2025; therefore, we anticipate a selection will be made by mid-July, with a final contract for Council approval in August 2025.  

As of October 2024, building services has promoted two development inspectors into management and lost one plumbing inspector to a different municipality. The promotions and losses have created a gap of three field positions in plan review and plumbing inspections, which warrants additional help from our third-party vendor.  

Carlisle Wortman has been a service provider to the Building and Rental Services area for over seven years, helping the service area maintain inspection and plan review expectations. This Amendment 1 to the Professional Services Agreement will enable Carlisle Wortman to extend additional resources to help meet the demands of inspections and plan review until City staff have backfilled open positions. 

The scope of work will remain the same, with no change in services or terms of the contract.  The contract includes administrative support, planning administration, building, trade, rental inspections within 24 hours of the City's request, and regular plan review services to meet service demand. These are on-call, need-based services designed to allow the Building and Rental department flexibility and capacity at high-demand times. The contract allows the City to temporarily fill gaps in staffing due to illness, turnover, or other unexpected circumstances. 

Budget/Fiscal Impact:  Funding is available for this contract in the Construction Code Fund expenditure budget.
..Staff
Prepared by:	Lisha Turner-Tolbert, Building and Rental Services Manager 
Reviewed by:	Derek Delacourt, Community Services Area Administrator 
Approved by:	Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, It is necessary to retain a qualified professional services firm to perform building, trade, and rental housing inspections, administrative support, planning administrative support, and plan review services when needed;

Whereas, The City currently has in place a Professional Services Agreement for On-Call Third Party Building, Rental, and Planning Services with Carlisle Wortman Associates, Inc. for these inspection, planning, administration, and plan review services (the "Agreement");

Whereas, the City requires an extension of the existing Agreement and additional funds to continue operations;

Whereas, All other terms and conditions in the Agreement will remain the same for the necessary services;

Whereas, Carlisle Wortman Associates, Inc. is in compliance with the City of Ann Arbor Non-Discrimination and Living Wage Ordinances;

Whereas, The costs for the building, rental, and planning services have been defined in the Agreement in terms of hourly fees specific to services provided; and

Whereas, Funding is available in the Construction Code Fund expenditure budget;

RESOLVED, That City Council approve Amendment 1 to the Professional Services Agreement Between Carlisle Wortman Associates, Inc. and the City of Ann Arbor for On-Call Third Party Building, Rental, and Planning Services ("Amendment") for an additional $300,000.00 (total of $750,000.00), extending the duration of the Agreement through August 31, 2025; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to take the necessary administrative actions to implement this resolution, including authority to terminate the Agreement administratively pursuant to its terms if deemed necessary.
